editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where a simple birthmark on your skin is basically a map of your past. In this story, people pay experts to scan these marks to figure out who they used to be and how they died. You follow a guy who is terrified of this process because he has a feeling his past life was something truly dark. The vibe is a mix of a mystery and a family drama, making you wonder if knowing the truth is actually better than just living in the moment. It keeps you guessing about whether the main character is a good person or just someone hiding a scary secret.

The acting is top-notch and the plot twists really land well, though some parts in the middle feel a bit slow. If you like stories that make you think about life and death without being too heavy, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that the main character was actually a notorious criminal in his past life who betrayed his own family. The big twist is that the person he loves now is the descendant of someone he killed. Instead of running away, he decides to use his current life to make things right. He confesses everything and finds peace, showing that you can change who you are regardless of your past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mystery stories about fate and second chances.
